title: CATWALK ANIMATION COMBO
features:
CATWALK — Animation Combo
This script replaces the character’s default movement animations with a custom animation combination:
🕺 Idle: Catwalk
🚶 Walk: Adidas Aura
🏃 Run: Adidas Aura
🦘 Jump: Adidas Aura
🪽 Fall: Adidas Aura
⚙️ How it works
Detects your character
The script waits for your Humanoid and creates/uses its Animator.
Resolves the animation IDs
The gRId() function attempts to resolve each supplied animation ID and caches successful results so they don't need to be resolved repeatedly.
Loads the animations
Each resolved animation is loaded onto your character and given high Action4 priority so it can override lower-priority movement animations.
Monitors your movement
A Heartbeat loop continuously checks the Humanoid's current state:
Standing → Catwalk idle
Moving → Adidas Aura walk
Jumping → Adidas Aura jump
Falling → Adidas Aura fall
Smoothly switches animations
When the required animation changes, other currently playing tracks are stopped and the appropriate track is played.
Handles respawning
When your character respawns, the script automatically runs the setup again and reloads the animation combination.
🔥 Result
You get a Catwalk + Adidas Aura hybrid animation pack without manually changing animations:
CATWALK IDLE → ADIDAS AURA WALK/RUN/JUMP/FALL
The script also prints loading/resolution information in the executor console so you can see whether each animation was successfully resolved.
